1. (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __that is distinct from merely creating access to the tissue__.

2. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic intervention beyond tissue displacement__.

3. (Original): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __such that the device creates a working channel that remains patent after partial or complete removal of the device__.

6. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the working channel through use of a reinforcing structure__.

7. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent or similar structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that includes delivery of a therapeutic agent or performance of a surgical intervention__.

8. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __that performs a function beyond tissue displacement__.

9. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered to treat a pathological condition__.

10. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __in a manner that creates a stable working channel__.

11. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while the reinforcing structure remains in place to maintain the working channel__.

12. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during or after introduction of the medical element__.

13. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that includes therapeutic delivery or surgical intervention beyond tissue displacement__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __while the stent remains in place__.

14. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __that performs a therapeutic function__.

15. (Original): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the stent provides permanent or semi-permanent structural support__.

17. (Original): The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
